answer: The shale counter is kept in walnut and reef shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2797 identities would post 3951 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
